note: Trego County KS has no queryable zoning district layer. County Public Works says it enforces zoning, but no county zoning map or GIS is published. The only zoning source found is WaKeeney's Chapter XVI zoning code as a text PDF with no district polygons. ArcGIS Hub/Online searches for Trego and Kansas zoning returned nothing for the county. The county's GIS viewer link is an image with no service behind it. Neighbouring Ellis County's layers and other Kansas zoning services do not cover Trego: the Zoning_Districts service has no features at the Trego point.
